title: Quote: We have an environment where excellence is really expected. ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: We have an environment where excellence is really expected. What's really great is to be open when [the work] is not great. My best contribution is not settling for anything but really good stuff, in all the details. That's my job -- to make sure everything is great.
